lines.text: Many learners say: I study in the night.
Say at night, with no the.

data.why: Say at night, with no the.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «في الليل»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول at night: “I study at night.” وليس “I study in the night.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I study in the night” 😅 نقول at night بلا the، فالجملة الصحيحة “I study at night.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “at” — نقول at night بلا the. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: We say at night, with no the: “I study at night.” not “I study in the night.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I study in the night” 😅 We say at night, with no the, so the right sentence is “I study at night.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
